agent_dto_projection.reason: The current AgentEntityDto projects the stored nullable tokenBudget; captured Python projections predate this field. New Rust projections must include its exact null value.

rust_receipts.reason: Rust immutable transport and lifecycle result receipts, absent in Python.
rust_receipts.returnContract: Python callbacks are compared by first-call row effects; their raw results are reported. Rust entry-point return values are pinned per case. Rust receipt replay alone must return the saved first result with zero total changes; changed content is refused without writes. Python callbacks have no corresponding idempotent receipt contract.

durable_reconciliation_hold.reason: Paused and generation-change recovery retain a named durable hold, and Rust recovery receipts keep their transport fields. A restart turn with a known turn identity, including a Python-submitted one, matches Python and is reconciled automatically from native history; submitted unpaused restart input without a turn identity is reconciled from exact native history.

unsent_input_kept.reason: A turn/start that the session proves it never wrote keeps its input pending, also after the durable submitted mark. Python failed that input although the provider never received it.
